purpose: Explain a phone-centered interface for remote coding agents

required_facts.fact: Persistent remote execution avoids losing work on disconnects.
tmux preserves sessions across SSH loss.
tmuxctl and Makefiles reduce phone typing.
Short aliases launch Claude, Codex and OpenCode.
The remote machine is isolated from production.
Automatic port forwarding enables phone browser previews.
Typeless and Recorder provide voice input.
A disposable HTML picker helps with visual choices.
Telegram and Recorder support article drafting while commuting.

author_attribution: Explain Alexey's supported setup without generalizing safety claims beyond his isolated machine.
